verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is documented as a full Postgres relational database, so joins, constraints and transactions come from Postgres itself. Raw SQL is available through the MCP `execute_sql` tool and the SQL tooling, and community users praise the underlying database. One user reports that PostgREST's limitations pushed them back to a custom API server, which suggests complex relational work through the auto-generated API layer can be constrained. Missing for 10: explicit docs on joins, foreign-key and check constraints, and transaction handling (especially via the REST/client APIs), plus independent hands-on corroboration of transactional queries.
